entries.092b1d916ea4a943: This is a business model in which the company procures semiconductors, electronic components and electronic application equipment from domestic and overseas manufacturers, adds technical support and maintenance and technical services, and sells them to a wide range of customers in consumer equipment, industrial equipment, automotive-related and medical fields.
entries.0edbb0bab2e3312b: This business sells various semiconductors such as analog ICs, memory ICs, microprocessors, application-specific ICs and custom ICs, as well as electronic components such as crystal units, connectors and passive components. In addition to the company, sales are made mainly in Asia by sales companies in Singapore and Hong Kong under Marubun/Arrow Asia,Ltd., a joint venture equally owned with Arrow Electronics,Inc. of the United States, and by Marubun Taiwan,Inc. in Taiwan, among others. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥152,245 million, accounting for about 7 tenths of consolidated sales. A major customer is Nintendo Co., Ltd., and sales to it in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥32,491 million.

entries.6e7868236b34a97d: This business sells ICT solutions, AI robots, module products, software and technology licenses. The company sells these products, and FORESIGHT TECHNO CO., LTD. provides maintenance and technical services for ICT solutions. Previously named the "Solution Business," the business was renamed in the fiscal year ended March 2026, when it transferred some businesses that had been included in the former Device Business and changed its name. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 2,556 million yen.
entries.6f29fca8085c5f5a: Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥213,425 million, up 1.2% from ¥210,837 million in the previous fiscal year. By segment, the Device Business had ¥152,245 million, the System Business ¥58,623 million, and the Entrepreneur Business ¥2,556 million. Demand for mobility and consumer equipment offset weak demand for industrial equipment, and in the System Business, demand related to artificial satellites grew significantly.
entries.8ea1f5a51024058d: In the Device Business, the company sells semiconductors such as analog ICs and memory ICs and electronic components; in the System Business, it sells electronic application equipment such as aerospace equipment, manufacturing and inspection equipment, laser equipment and medical equipment; and in the Entrepreneur Business, it sells ICT solutions, AI robots, software and other products. The consolidated subsidiary Fōsaito Tekuno Co., Ltd. is responsible for maintenance and technical services for electronic application equipment and ICT solutions.
